name: quote_all_identifiers
description: When enabled, forces PostgreSQL to quote all identifiers (e.g., table names, column names) in generated SQL output, including EXPLAIN plans and catalog functions like pg_get_viewdef.
symptoms: SQL output incompatible with older PostgreSQL versions
Identifier name conflicts due to case sensitivity or special characters
pg_dump or pg_dumpall output fails to restore on systems requiring strict quoting
Unexpected parsing errors when reusing generated SQL in heterogeneous environments
tuning_tips: Enable 'on' only when interoperability with external tools (e.g., pg_dump --quote-all-identifiers) or cross-version compatibility requires consistent identifier quoting; disable ('off') for default, more readable SQL output.
